# SEO & Discovery Encyclopedia

## Meta Tags

```html
<title>Chronos: AI Chronicles</title>
<meta name="description" content="AI-driven RPG with procedurally generated stories...">
<meta property="og:title" content="Chronos: AI Chronicles">
<meta property="og:description" content="Experience a unique story every playthrough...">
<meta name="keywords" content="rpg,ai,procedural,indie-game,story">
```

## Search Engine Keywords

### Primary
- AI generated game
- Procedural RPG
- Indie RPG

### Secondary  
- Story game
- Open world RPG
- Single player RPG

### Long-tail
- RPG with unique story every playthrough
- AI narrative game

## Platform Tags

- Steam: RPG, Adventure, Casual
- itch.io: RPG, Simulation
- Google Play: RPG,Adventure,Offline
- iOS: RPG,Adventure,Strategy

## ASO (App Store)

### Screenshots
- 3-5 images
- First image = hook
- Show gameplay

### Description
- First 100 chars = crucial
- Feature bullets
- Call to action
